definitions.explanation: Government by a king or emperor, as a system; used mostly in history and politics.

examples.japanese: {王政|おうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{廃止|はいし}→廃止：12483_haishi⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧{王政|おうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: That country was ruled by a monarchy for a long time.

examples.japanese: ⟦フランス→フランス：19418_furansu⟧⟦{革命|かくめい}→革命：05968_kakumei⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧{王政|おうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{倒|たお}れ→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧、{共和政|きょうわせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The French Revolution overthrew the monarchy and a republic began.

notes:
A term from history textbooks. In Japanese history it appears in {王政復古|おうせいふっこ}, the 1868 restoration of imperial rule.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {王政|おうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{倒|たお}す→倒す：01954_taosu⟧: to overthrow the monarchy
- {王政|おうせい}{復古|ふっこ}: restoration of monarchy (the Meiji Restoration declaration)
- {絶対王政|ぜったいおうせい}: absolute monarchy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{君主制|くんしゅせい}→君主制：21776_kunshusei⟧: monarchy — the political-science term
- ⟦{共和制|きょうわせい}→共和制：22243_kyouwasei⟧: republic — the opposite

WATCH OUT:
Not to be confused with its homophone ⟦{旺盛|おうせい}→旺盛：09331_ousei⟧ (vigorous, as in {食欲旺盛|しょくよくおうせい}).
